name: RareBench
description: RareBench is a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in diagnosing rare diseases. It includes the largest open-source dataset on rare disease patients and measures LLMs' performance on four critical dimensions within the rare disease domain.
reputation: A specialized rare-disease benchmark that is cited in medical LLM evaluation work, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Includes a dynamic few-shot prompt methodology leveraging a rare disease knowledge graph; compares GPT-4 diagnostic capabilities against specialist physicians.
